steps.title: Analyze Request and App Requirements
steps.description: Understand user request to build a minimalist Hello app with an intentional syntax error in MainActivity.java to force a build failure.

steps.title: Define Project Structure and Configuration
steps.description: Set up metadata and build files consistent with the requirements.

steps.title: Configure Build Settings in Gradle
steps.description: Create the app build.gradle specifying compile and target SDKs as 34 and standard namespace configurations.

steps.title: Create Application Manifest
steps.description: Write AndroidManifest.xml referencing the launcher Activity, correct themes, and launch filters.

steps.title: Design the Main Layout UI
steps.description: Write activity_main.xml layout to center-align the Hello message on the screen.

steps.title: Implement Main Activity Code with Intentional Syntax Error
steps.description: Implement MainActivity.java with a deliberate syntax error as explicitly requested by the user, causing the upcoming build to fail.

steps.title: Review Manifest Validation
steps.description: Confirm that manifest declarations align correctly with the package name space and required icon pathways.

steps.title: Verify Target SDK Compatibility
steps.description: Ensure compilation configs meet standard SDK version 34 criteria.

steps.title: Trigger Build Pipeline Validation
steps.description: Prepare local build assets for triggering code validation processes.

steps.title: Building Hello Fail App
steps.description: Execute gradle assembleDebug to run compilation. A failure is expected at the compileJava stage due to the introduced syntax error.
